lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when persisting the post attempt result of a fallible action not raw caller intent add a test that forces the action to fail and asserts the persisted value reflects the failure success path only tests won t catch a regression that persists intent instead of outcome
lessons.text: When persisting the post-attempt result of a fallible action (not raw caller intent), add a test that forces the action to fail and asserts the persisted value reflects the failure — success-path-only tests won't catch a regression that persists intent instead of outcome.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec edge case says only one attempt no retry loop assert the actual call count e g activatecalls 1 in the failure path test not just the final state a loop can produce the same final state as a single attempt
lessons.text: When a spec edge case says 'only one attempt, no retry loop', assert the actual call count (e.g. activateCalls == 1) in the failure-path test, not just the final state — a loop can produce the same final state as a single attempt.
evidence: spec.md Edge Case 2 (no retry loop on restore failure) (testing,edge-cases)

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an ac states x or y as alternative preconditions e g false or absent write a separate test for each precondition even if they re indistinguishable at the storage read layer the consuming code path may still deserve independent proof
lessons.text: When an AC states 'X or Y' as alternative preconditions (e.g. 'false or absent'), write a separate test for each precondition even if they're indistinguishable at the storage-read layer — the consuming code path may still deserve independent proof.
evidence: spec.md P1 AC5 (stored pref false or absent) (testing,acceptance-criteria)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a spec criterion is a conjunction assert every clause including the unchanged state clause not only the state that transitions
lessons.text: When a spec criterion is a conjunction, assert every clause including the unchanged-state clause, not only the state that transitions
